status: Proposal only; not implemented or published
originalLogoPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE new original premium fantasy strategy game logo on a genuinely transparent background, not a presentation board. This replaces a rejected logo with three castle towers. The game is FORGED ALLIANCES, a tower defense game about Human, Dwarven and Elven alliances.
The emblem must give all THREE alliances equal visual importance and communicate that they are forged together into one alliance. Build a single compact, memorable heraldic emblem with three interlocking forged-metal segments in an approximately circular shield silhouette. Inside the unified silhouette incorporate THREE clear, distinct, balanced symbols: a strong simplified lion head for Humans, a broad sturdy anvil for Dwarves, and an elegant three-leaf sprig for Elves. Lion, anvil and leaf must have comparable visual weight; do not make the lion the dominant mascot or reduce the other two to tiny decorations. Each symbol should remain understandable in a small game header. Carefully integrate the three motifs into one coherent mark, not three unrelated badges pasted beside each other.
Use clean confident vector-like curves and deliberate negative space, subtle handcrafted bevels, antique brass and copper highlights, deep forest teal #173d3c, muted sage/emerald for the Elven segment. Overall silhouette strong and balanced; premium but restrained, not overly ornate. Avoid tiny filigree. No castle, towers, battlements, crown, laurel wreath, generic crossed swords, existing franchise symbols, runic text or random gemstones. No photorealistic metal rendering.
Horizontal logo lockup: unified emblem on LEFT; a large highly legible dark forest-teal fantasy-serif wordmark on RIGHT, two balanced lines, exact text "FORGED" then "ALLIANCES", with modest brass accents. Beneath the wordmark exact smaller descriptor "TOWER DEFENSE" with generous letter spacing. Typography elegant with crisp edges, not aggressively spiky, and clearly readable when reduced. The letters should be solid dark teal suited to a light parchment UI. Do not produce a detached "TD" badge.
The emblem and wordmark together should fill the canvas with modest clearspace and a wide approximately 3:1 overall aspect ratio. Transparent alpha everywhere outside the logo. No white or checkerboard background painted into the image, no shadows extending far outside the silhouette, no extra text, no multiple variants or samples. This is a proposed visual identity for an existing game; do not imply that it is already implemented.
presentationPrompt:
Use case: product-mockup / logo-brand presentation.
Create one clean brand presentation board, wide landscape, using reference image1 as the EXACT logo identity. Preserve its single circular three-part forged shield, lion in top segment, copper anvil lower-left, Elven three-leaf sprig lower-right, and the exact wordmark FORGED ALLIANCES with TOWER DEFENSE beneath. This is a presentation of the logo, not a redesign or another option.
Place the same horizontal logo large and clearly centered on a flat warm ivory parchment #f5edd7 field, with a generous modest clear margin and a very restrained thin antique-brass border. Very subtle paper grain only. No perspective, no 3D object mockup, no desk, no extra characters, no extra symbols. The dark forest-teal lettering must have excellent contrast against ivory. Keep its proportions and all three motif identities, clean edges and high quality. No castle towers. Do not add explanations, captions, labels, slogans, sample variants or watermarks. The original transparent logo remains an independent unchanged asset; this is a separate viewing board so the dark lettering can be read against a light game-interface background.
